    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 13,
    'axes.titlesize': 14,
    'axes.labelsize': 14,
    'xtick.labelsize': 13,

    'figure.dpi': 300,

})

    [ 0.0,  6.6, 72.9, 20.4],

])

    [99.3,  0.7,  0.0,  0.0],
    [ 1.5, 75.5, 17.4,  5.6],
    [ 0.4, 22.1, 43.3, 34.2],
    [ 0.3,  7.8, 33.1, 58.8],
])

labels = ['d0', 'd1', 'd2', 'd3']
panels = [
    (cm_best, 'GPT-2 XL / temp (best, 85.9%)'),
    (cm_loo, 'OLMo holdout (best LOO, 69.2%)'),
]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
